exercises.instruction: Some of these sentences are OK, but some need the (sometimes more than once). Correct the sentences where necessary.

items.prompt: Milan and Turin are cities in north of Italy.
answers: Milan and Turin are cities in the north of Italy.

items.prompt: Africa is much larger than Europe.
Last year I visited Mexico and United States.
answers: Last year I visited Mexico and the United States.

items.prompt: Southern England is warmer than north.
answers: Southern England is warmer than the north.

items.prompt: Thailand and Cambodia are in southeast Asia.
Next year we're going skiing in Swiss Alps.
answers: Next year we're going skiing in the Swiss Alps.

items.prompt: UK consists of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
answers: The UK consists of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

items.prompt: Seychelles are a group of islands in Indian Ocean.
answers: The Seychelles are a group of islands in the Indian Ocean.

items.prompt: I've never been to South Africa.
River Volga flows into Caspian Sea.
answers: The River Volga flows into the Caspian Sea.
